verses.text: The land given by lot to Joseph's descendants began at the Jordan near Jericho, east of the springs of Jericho. It went up from Jericho through the desert and the hill country to Bethel.
From Bethel, which is Luz, it went on to the land of the Arkites at Ataroth.
Then it went down west to the land of the Japhletites, as far as Lower Beth Horon, then on to Gezer, and ended at the sea.
So Manasseh and Ephraim, the descendants of Joseph, received their land.
This was the land of Ephraim, clan by clan. Their border on the east went from Ataroth Addar to Upper Beth Horon,
and on to the sea. From Mikmethath on the north it curved east to Taanath Shiloh and passed by it to Janoah on the east.
Then it went down from Janoah to Ataroth and Naarah, touched Jericho, and came out at the Jordan.
From Tappuah the border went west to the Kanah Ravine and ended at the sea. This was the land of the tribe of Ephraim, clan by clan.
It also included all the towns and villages set apart for Ephraim inside the land of Manasseh.
They did not drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer. To this day the Canaanites live among the people of Ephraim, but they are made to do forced labour.
